title: TrafficReport
description: What any source of observed traffic produces (ADR 0039).

lookback_secs.description:
The longest lookback the source asked, when it asked one: `seen` covers up to here, and
a part not in it was not seen that far back.

seen.description:
Edges with calls in a longer lookback but none in the window (ADR 0083). Empty when the
source asked no lookback, or nothing was seen.

truncated.description: The source cut the edges at `MAX_EDGES`.

window_secs.description: How far back the counts reach.

SeenEdge.description: Calls seen in a lookback longer than the report's window, but none in the window (ADR 0083).

within_secs.description: The shortest lookback with calls, in seconds: one of `LOOKBACK_SECS`.

TrafficEdge.description:
Calls observed from one service to another in a report's window: the shape of the
OpenTelemetry Collector `servicegraph` connector's output.

client_namespace.description:
OpenTelemetry `service.namespace` of the caller, as it emits it; absent when it emits
none, as a servicegraph virtual node from `peer.service` does (ADR 0059).

server_namespace.description: OpenTelemetry `service.namespace` of the callee, as it emits it.
